lines.text: AMC eight tip! Think you should leave hard questions blank? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 tip! Think you should leave hard questions blank? Nope!

lines.text: The AMC eight has twenty-five questions. Each right answer earns one point.
lines.caption: The AMC 8 has 25 questions. Each right answer earns one point.

lines.text: What does a wrong answer cost you? A: one point. B: a quarter point. C: nothing.
lines.caption: What does a wrong answer cost you? A: one point. B: a quarter point. C: nothing.

lines.text: A right answer earns one point. A wrong answer earns zero.
lines.caption: A right answer earns one point. A wrong answer earns zero.

lines.text: And a blank? Also zero. So a guess can only help.
lines.caption: And a blank? Also zero. So a guess can only help.

lines.text: A wild guess has a one in five chance. Cross out two choices, and it's one in three.
lines.caption: A wild guess has a one in 5 chance. Cross out 2 choices, and it's one in 3.

lines.text: The answer is C. A wrong answer costs you nothing!
lines.caption: The answer is C. A wrong answer costs you nothing!

lines.text: Leaving it blank was the trap. Answer every question.
